snippet.title: Sort Inc. - Help Nina Sort Customer's Items into Boxes - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.

Play the free Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989530/Sort_Inc/
